subject: Geopolitics
title: RCEP: Asia's Trade Mega-Deal
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: RCEP: Asia's Trade Mega-Deal.

hook.text: RCEP is the world's largest trade bloc: 15 nations, 30% of global GDP. The US isn't in it. China is.

buildup.text: The Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership links China, Japan, South Korea, ASEAN, Australia, and New Zealand.

discovery.text: RCEP standardizes trade rules across Asia. It reduces tariffs and simplifies supply chains for member nations.

twist.text: The US withdrew from the rival TPP in 2017. That vacuum let China shape Asia's trade architecture instead.

climax.text: Trade agreements are geopolitical tools. Being inside the bloc gives influence. Being outside gives isolation.

punchline.text: The nation that writes the trade rules writes the future.

quiz.question: Why is the US absent from RCEP?
options: The US was never invited to join
The US withdrew from the rival TPP, ceding trade leadership to China
